exposure: Medtronic 640G or 740G insulin pump with PLGS
Integration between insulin pump and CGM
cohort: The study included 90 children and adolescents with type 1 diabetes (T1DM) who were treated with different models of insulin pumps.
finding: Any integration between an insulin pump and CGM, especially more advanced technologies like the Medtronic 780G, was associated with better glycemic control (higher time in range and lower glucose variability) in youths with T1DM.
